body:
`src/app/api/search/route.ts` queries residents, houses, streets, payment_records, security_contacts and documents, and returns them to **any authenticated user**. The only auth touch is `supabase.auth.getUser()`, used solely to attach `user_id` to the search log — never to scope results.

The 4 hardcoded `QUICK_ACTIONS` in `src/components/dashboard/global-search-command.tsx` are likewise shown unconditionally, so "Create Invoice" and "Add House" appear for roles holding neither permission.

This contradicts the rest of the app: both the main sidebar (`useSectionedNavigation`) and the settings sidebar (`useSettingsNavigation`) permission-filter precisely so the UI does not advertise pages a role cannot open.

Deliberately scoped out of the Settings IA work, which filters only the settings entries it adds.

Fix: filter each result category by the permission that gates its section, and filter Quick Actions by the permission their target route requires.

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

title: Global search returns results with no permission filtering
